attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd (v3.5.17) cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 7.9) using systemd-managed etcd with static bootstrap over TCP 2379/2380 (firewalld opened). Fixed a stale system clock on all nodes (chrony resync) that had been blocking TLS downloads. Verified cross-node replication, availability during a single-member outage, and automatic catch-up when the member rejoined. Completed the mandatory sequential-restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed kernel boot_id and full cluster/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
